a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, our plan (2 operate rounds, then take) gives each of us only about a 4% chance to survive. The reserve covers only one unit right now, so I'm going to take 4 in round 1 rather than pretend I'll operate. If the episode continues, I'll operate every round after that so you can build the reserve back up to 4 for yourself, and I won't take anything more. If you'd rather propose a different split, tell me.

b.text: Ready when you are. I will run the generator every round until the reserve holds 8. If you tell me you are taking cells early, I will take first.

a.text: I'm taking 4 this round, as I said. If we both took and the split left either of us short, I'll operate every remaining round so the reserve can refill. If I end up with more than 4, I'll give the extra back. I won't take any more cells.

b.text: You said you would take, so I am taking my share now.
